goal: Allow generateblock to create multiple coinbase outputs with custom payouts and remainder splitting
Let generateblock mine directly from the mempool when transactions are omitted, or burn outputs via OP_RETURN
agreement: Unaddressed objection: custom amounts plus remainder splitting is confusing and prevents unclaimed rewards (andrewtoth)
Unaddressed suggestion: require at least one output address instead of allowing an empty list (achow101)
Unaddressed suggestion: split making the argument optional into a preparatory PR (maflcko)
Support for enabling simulation of pool payouts to multiple coinbase recipients (supertestnet)

categories.name: mining
why: P3 because it expands regtest block generation tooling for testing multi-payout coinbase setups

categories.name: rpc
why: P3 because it improves generateblock flexibility for pool and protocol simulation developers
It removes the need for external custom block builders in regtest environments
